integrity: Analytical proof accompanied by supplementary finite checks; no independent external audit, calibration or observational validation.
scientific_limitations: Valid only for exact Planck continua, fixed area weights, a single-temperature reference chord, and a compact positive temperature distribution with cool and warm support; physical atmospheres, limb darkening, spectral lines, and restricted bandpasses need not obey it.
title: A single chromatic cancellation pivot for arbitrary mixed-temperature blackbody photospheres
